subject: Acceptance timeline worksheet & slide seed — share and next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Lin <kate@averysys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance timeline worksheet & slide seed — share and next steps

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the time this morning. As discussed, attaching the first-pass Acceptance Timeline worksheet and a two-slide seed we can use in the exec review. The goal here is to make the pilot onboarding and evaluation checkpoints explicit so your team and ours can align on expectations for success.

Attachments (stubs):
- Acceptance-Timeline-Worksheet-v0.xlsx (worksheet with milestones, owners, acceptance criteria)
- Pilot-Onboarding-Slides-v0.pptx (2-slide exec summary + milestone timeline)

Proposed next steps:
1) You review the sheet and confirm the key stakeholders (we assigned based on our call).
2) We co-edit a short MAP doc in Google Docs that translates worksheet items into commitments and dates. I seeded a GDoc (link below) and a slide stub for the executive summary.
3) Schedule a 30-min alignment meeting next week to lock dates and owners — would Tue/Wed work for your team?

Google Doc (seed): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDEFgHIjK-sample-link
HubSpot (deal): HS-23891

Open questions I noted while building the worksheet:
- Does your security team require the pilot to run in a VPC for early testing or can it start in our hosted environment?
- Any mandatory compliance evidence (e.g., SOC2 report) we should attach now for procurement?

Happy to iterate — looping Marissa and Jonas to handle technical owners and SOW questions.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

-----

From: Kate Lin <kate@averysys.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 12:03:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Acceptance timeline worksheet & slide seed — share and next steps

Thanks, Sergio — this is helpful. I reviewed the worksheet quickly and it maps well to our pilot goals. A couple notes:

- Security: we'll need the SOC2 report and a short summary of data residency for the test data. I'll ping our security lead to confirm if VPC is mandatory.
- Stakeholders: can you add an "internal approver" column we can use for our legal and procurement countersign?

For the alignment meeting, Wed 8/30 10:00–10:30 PT works on our side. If you can lock that and share a calendar invite we'll be good.

Also curious: can the MAP include a rollback trigger if model quality drops below a threshold during the pilot? We typically bake that in.

Thanks — Kate
Kate Lin
Head of Product, Avery Systems
kate@averysys.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance timeline worksheet & slide seed — internal co-edit suggestions

Sergio / Jonas —

Thanks for looping us in. I pulled the worksheet into a quick MAP doc and added suggested acceptance criteria for the first three milestones (week0 sandbox, week2 quality check, week4 integration smoke test). A few practical notes:

- I added an "internal approver" column as Kate requested and populated with Procurement / Legal placeholder contacts.
- For the rollback trigger Kate mentioned, I drafted a simple clause: "If validation metrics fall >15% below the baseline in two consecutive evaluation windows, automated fallback to the previous model variant will be triggered and an incident review will be scheduled within 48 hours." We can tighten language with legal later.
- Security artifacts: Jonas, can you attach the SOC2 link + short note about data residency (hosted vs. VPC) to the MAP doc? I'll call out the items in the slide notes.

I created two artifacts and added comments:
- Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDEFgHIjK-sample-link (MAP draft v0)
- Slide seed (view): https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/AVY/RD-12345

I'll propose owners for the technical checkpoints but want to confirm with Jonas on feasibility of week2 evaluation windows — some workloads need longer to collect stable metrics.

Thanks — I can join the Wed 8/30 cadence — please send the invite.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Date: Sun, 25 Aug 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized MAP draft & Wed 8/30 alignment invite

Hi Kate —

Thanks for the quick review and for confirming Wed 8/30 10:00–10:30 PT. Calendar invite sent. I also pushed a few edits to the MAP doc based on Marissa's suggestions and Jonas's note (SOC2 link + data residency stub added).

Quick summary of what we updated in the MAP:
- Week0: Sandbox provisioning (owner: Redwood SRE) — expected completion 9/6
- Week2: Quality evaluation window (owner: Avery product analytics) — pass/fail criteria added
- Week4: Integration smoke test + exec sign-off (owners: Avery Eng + Redwood CS)
- Rollback trigger clause included (Marissa's drafted language)
- Internal approver column added for Procurement/Legal

Links / artifacts: 
- MAP draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDEFgHIjK-sample-link
- Slides: https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/AVY/RD-12345
- Attachments uploaded to HubSpot: HS-23891 > Files (Acceptance-Timeline-Worksheet-v0.xlsx, Pilot-Onboarding-Slides-v0.pptx)

If there's anything you'd like us to change before Wed, comment directly in the doc and we'll address it in the pre-meeting sync. Otherwise we'll use the 30-min alignment to lock dates and owners and confirm procurement path.

Best regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
